data.name: Angil
data.gender_notes: Angil is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Anglo-Saxon words 'ange' meaning 'messenger' and 'weal' meaning 'God'. Angil was a common name in early Christian communities, reflecting the belief in God's messengers and angels. The name Angil carries the meaning “Messenger of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Angil usually hope their child will grow to embody messenger of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A reminder of the divine presence and guidance in one's life.
data.etymology: Angil belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Messenger of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Angil total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
